changelog:
Initial release of Bird Buddy skill.

- Query your Bird Buddy smart bird feeder for status, battery, food level, and signal strength.
- View recent bird visitors with species identification and sighting photos.
- Requires the pybirdbuddy Python package and Bird Buddy email/password login.
- Includes commands to check feeder status, list recent sightings, view feed, and get full details for specific bird sightings.
summary: Query your Bird Buddy smart bird feeder - check status, battery, food level, and see recent bird visitors with species identification.
